description: Defines functions and structures related to default PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) time domain resource allocation in 5G NR, including configuration retrieval based on TS38.214 specifications.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Determines the default PUSCH time-domain resource allocation A based on cyclic prefix, row index, and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Provides a list of valid default PUSCH time-domain resource allocations for given cyclic prefix and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pusch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of valid PUSCH time-domain allocations based on search space configuration, active BWP uplink common and dedicated configurations.
